name: Isiqalo Med
summary: A secure medical case registry for South African practitioners. Clinicians register cases with their STL, DICOM and X-ray files, patient identity data is encrypted at rest, and records export as JSON, CSV, PDF or ZIP, with every sensitive action written to a tamper-evident audit log.
imageAlt: Isiqalo Med data extraction screen listing five demo patient records with condition, priority and date logged

name: Rejuv Aesthetics

name: This portfolio
